title: Trainer – Data Analytics, Data Science & AI
description:
Join IPSR and help shape industry\-ready AI professionals.

Position: Trainer – Data Analytics, Data Science \& AI  
Location: Kochi / Kottayam  
Experience: 1–3 Years

Role Overview

We are looking for an enthusiastic trainer with strong skills in Data Analytics and Data Visualisation, along with working knowledge of Data Science and AI.

The ideal candidate should have excellent communication skills, a passion for training and mentoring, and the willingness to continuously learn and stay updated with emerging tools and technologies.

Key Responsibilities

* Deliver IPSR training programmes in Data Analytics, Data Visualisation, Data Science and related areas.
* Conduct practical sessions using real\-world datasets, dashboards, reports and business use cases.
* Train students in tools and technologies such as Excel, SQL, Power BI, Python and relevant data visualisation platforms.
* Introduce appropriate concepts and applications of Data Science, Machine Learning and AI as part of the learning journey.
* Prepare and regularly update training materials, assignments, assessments and practical projects.
* Mentor students in analytics projects and help them develop industry\-relevant skills.
* Work closely with IPSR's AI and development teams for knowledge transfer, bringing real\-world industry practices and project exposure into student training.
* Stay updated on emerging analytics, visualisation and AI tools and incorporate relevant developments into training.
* Support workshops and training programmes conducted at colleges and partner institutions.
* Travel to colleges and other IPSR locations on a need basis.

Desired Skills

* Strong knowledge of Data Analytics and Data Visualisation.
* Proficiency in Excel, SQL and Power BI.
* Working knowledge of Python for Data Analytics.
* Understanding of statistics, data interpretation and dashboard development.
* Basic understanding of Data Science, Machine Learning and Generative AI.
* Excellent communication, presentation and classroom engagement skills.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Passion for teaching, mentoring and continuous learning.

Eligibility

* B.Tech / MCA / M.Sc. / relevant postgraduate or graduate qualification preferred.
* Candidates from other disciplines with strong Data Analytics and Data Visualisation skills may also be considered.
* 1–3 years of relevant training, academic or industry experience preferred.

How to Apply

Send your resume and cover letter to hr@ipsrsolutions.com

Join IPSR and help build the next generation of data\-driven professionals.

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Kochi, Kerala

**Experience:** 0–2 Years

* Conduct sessions on Python, Data Science, Machine Learning, and related topics.
* Guide students through practical exercises and projects.
* Assist students with project development and troubleshooting.
* Prepare and update training materials and assignments.
* Evaluate student work and provide technical feedback.
* Support regular training programs and workshops.

Technical Skills

* Good knowledge of **Python and Data Science fundamentals**.
* Basic understanding of **Machine Learning, SQL, Statistics, and Data Visualization**.
